notes.title: STAGE 2: THE TUNNELS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Dear player,

Damage Control Studios is presenting you with a late week gift! Our first HUGE update is now available for everyone! The new level, with some big improvements is now available. Mysteries of The Abyss awaits you!

PATCH NOTES:

- Stage 2: The Tunnel
- Save/load game
-Optimization improvement (system requirements lowered)
- Some Minor Bug Fixes
